record.question: (a) United Industries Ltd. has an investment budget of ₹100 lakh for 2016-17. It has shortlisted two projects A and B after completing the market and technical appraisals. The management wants to complete the financial appraisal before making the investment. Further particulars regarding the two projects are given: Project A: Investment required ₹100 lakh, Average annual cash inflow before depreciation and tax ₹28 lakh, Salvage value - Nil, Estimated life - 10 years. Project B: Investment required ₹90 lakh, Average annual cash inflow before depreciation and tax ₹24 lakh, Salvage value - Nil, Estimated life - 10 years. The company follows straight line method of charging depreciation. Its tax rate is 50%. Calculate Pay-back period for each project.
